meta.name: apify-product-lookup
meta.description: Fetch a real product's current price, stock, rating, or images from retailer pages over the Apify MCP server, and return them as typed fields rather than prose. Use when someone asks what a product costs right now, whether it is in stock, how it is rated, to compare a product across retailers, or to check a product URL they pasted. Also use when an agent would otherwise answer a product question from training data. Not for managing your own store's catalog, not for payments, and not for questions answerable without live retailer data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查商品在零售商网站的价格、库存和评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要给用户实时且准确的产品价格和库存信息
copy.tagline_en: Look up a product's live price, stock, rating, and images from retailers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need current product data without relying on training memory

howto.what: 装上后，面对需要实时零售数据的商品询问，Claude 会通过 Apify 服务读取零售商网页，把当前价格、库存、评分、图片等作为结构化字段返回，并注明读取时间和来源链接，而不是按训练数据旧信息作答。
howto.when: 当用户问某商品的当前价格、库存或评分等实时信息时触发；在跨店比价、核对粘贴链接等需要查网页的请求下，或当 Claude 准备用训练数据回答商品问题时，也会接管。

say.text: 我刚发的链接里，这个商品现在卖多少钱？
say.note: 触发按 URL 查价，返回结构化价格与来源。

say.text: 在亚马逊上找一款 100 美元以内的机械键盘。
say.note: 会按关键词在亚马逊搜索并返回匹配项价格等。

say.text: 看看我刚发的这个商品链接，评分多少？
say.note: 读取该页评分字段；若缺失会说明。

howto.what_en: Fetches current product data (price, stock, rating, images) from retailer pages via Apify, returns structured fields, and states read time and source URL rather than answering from training data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about a product's current price, stock, or rating, when comparison or pasted-URL checking needs live page data, or when the agent would otherwise answer the product question from training data.

say_en.text: How much does the product in the link I just sent cost right now?
say_en.note: Triggers a URL lookup and returns a structured price with source.

say_en.text: Find a mechanical keyboard under $100 on Amazon.
say_en.note: Searches Amazon by keyword and returns matching products with prices.

say_en.text: What's the rating of the product in the link I just sent?
say_en.note: Reads the rating field from that page; says if it is missing.
